title: Terminal
wrap_on: Wrap long lines: on (fold at the panel's width)
wrap_off: Wrap long lines: off (scroll sideways at the computer's width)
busy_title: Another program on the computer is using this terminal
busy_detail: Another herdr client, for example. Taking control disconnects it and sizes the terminal to this panel. The terminal returns to the computer's size when you close this panel.
paste_detail: A shell may run multi-line text one line at a time.
history_limit: — herdr keeps only the last ~1000 lines. Earlier output is in the chat —
load_older: Scroll up to load earlier output
size_poll_hint: This computer can't stream the terminal, so the screen is read once a second
size_poll_fast_hint: This computer can't stream the terminal, so the screen is read several times a second while it changes
size_watch_hint: You can only watch here, not type
mode_control_hint: The terminal on the computer fits this panel. Anything you type here goes to that terminal.
mode_watch_hint: The terminal on the computer keeps its size. You can't type here.
grid_pane: The terminal on the computer is {cols} columns × {rows} rows
stopped: This session has ended. Resume it in this tab.
stopped_closed: This session has ended and its tab is closed. Resume it in a new tab.
